mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payroll_batches (company_id, name, period_start, period_end, status, total_amount, worker_count) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{name}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{workerCount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payroll_batches WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM payroll_batches WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE payroll_batches SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
